aboutGame.title: What is Dandelion Void?
paragraphs: Dandelion Void is a sci-fi survival crafting game developed by Manzanita Interactive and published by Kwalee. You wake aboard a derelict arkship drifting between the stars, where jungle-choked corridors have overgrown with alien flora and the skeletal remains of your ancestors are yours to scavenge.

Play solo or team up with friends in online co-op, forage resources, craft whatever weapons you can, and build a refuge that keeps you alive. Our Dandelion Void wiki gathers survival guides, crafting recipes, base-building tips, creature lore, and release information so you can survive your first night and push deeper into the ship.

modules.name: Dandelion Void Survival Guide
modules.description: A first-hour survival plan for Dandelion Void: how to scout, gather, shelter, and avoid the mistakes that end runs early.

highlights.detail: Scout a loop around your spawn before committing to a direction, and note three landmarks you can run back to.
Craft basic tools early so gathering stops being a hand-only bottleneck and speeds up every later trip.
Secure a repeatable food and water source instead of relying on a one-off meal.
Place a minimal shelter, one room with a sleep spot and storage, before the light drops.
Keep a 3-2-1 stockpile: three days of consumables, two stacks of building material, one stack of rare items.

modules.description: How the Dandelion Void crafting loop works, from raw salvage to finished gear, and how to plan upgrades instead of hoarding.

highlights.label: Gather
highlights.detail: Collect only the raw materials your current target recipe actually needs.

highlights.label: Refine
highlights.detail: Batch-refine raw materials after every few runs instead of one item at a time.

highlights.label: Combine
highlights.detail: Commit to one build at a time and keep a backup plan for shared components.

highlights.label: Upgrade
highlights.detail: Improve gear you use in real fights, and test each craft in the content that blocked you.

faq.title: Dandelion Void FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Dandelion Void.

items.question: What is Dandelion Void?
items.answer: Dandelion Void is a sci-fi survival crafting game from Manzanita Interactive, published by Kwalee. You explore a derelict arkship overgrown with alien jungle, scavenge resources, craft weapons, and build a refuge while uncovering what happened to the ship's lost crew.

items.question: Is Dandelion Void multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes. Dandelion Void supports single-player as well as online co-op and PvP, so you can survive the arkship solo or team up with friends.

items.question: When does Dandelion Void release?
items.answer: Dandelion Void is still in development with a release window of 2027. You can wishlist it on Steam to be notified when a firm Dandelion Void release date is announced.

items.question: What platforms is Dandelion Void on?
items.answer: Dandelion Void is confirmed for PC via Steam, including Steam Workshop support. Console versions have not been confirmed yet.

items.question: How much will Dandelion Void cost?
items.answer: A final Dandelion Void price has not been announced. Check the official Steam page for pricing and edition details as launch approaches.

items.question: Does Dandelion Void have codes?
items.answer: No. Dandelion Void is a paid survival crafting game on Steam rather than a free-to-play experience, so there are no redeem codes or code rewards to claim.
